input.question: From a scientific viewpoint, are thoughts and consciousness "real"? In what sense do they "exist"?
input.ground_truth: They exist in the sense that they are somewhat consistent emergent phenomenon within the system of human brains. As the product of neurological activity they are not clearly different fundamentally from the behaviors of other creatures, although distinctive enough to differentiate for our purposes.
